zh.title: 记忆：Zaovra 会记住以前对话里的事
zh.description: 你说过“以后都……”“记住……”的话、项目里跑通过的测试和构建命令，会留到以后的对话里用；模型也可以查到本项目以前的对话。每个项目各记各的

zh.title: 记了什么你都看得到、改得了
zh.description: 设置里新增“记忆”页：每一条都能改、能删、能清空，删掉的不会再被记回来；不想用可以一键关闭，已有的笔记不会丢

zh.title: 整理记忆由你决定
zh.description: “现在整理”会开一个普通对话，逐条核对笔记、标出过时的、合并重复的，最多用 30 万 token；你不点它不会运行

zh.title: 补丁格式不完整也能改文件
zh.description: 模型写补丁时漏掉开头或结尾标记，以前会直接失败，现在能正常应用

zh.title: 停止标记不再挂错位置
zh.description: 任务里跑过命令再点停止，“已停止”现在标在你发的那条消息上

en.title: Memory: Zaovra remembers earlier conversations
en.description: Things you said with "from now on" or "remember", and the test and build commands that worked in a project, carry into later conversations; the model can also look up earlier conversations in the same project. Each project keeps its own

en.title: You can see and change everything it kept
en.description: A new Memory page in Settings lets you edit, delete or clear every note; a deleted note is not recorded again. One switch turns memory off without losing existing notes

en.title: Tidying memory is your call
en.description: "Tidy now" starts an ordinary conversation that checks each note, marks what is out of date and merges repeats, using at most 300,000 tokens. It never runs unless you press it

en.title: Patches with a missing marker still apply
en.description: When a model leaves off the opening or closing marker of a patch, the edit used to fail; it now applies

en.title: Stop is shown on the right message
en.description: After a task that ran commands, pressing Stop now marks the message you sent
